en.headline: Centre for Health Protection investigates new mpox case in 41-year-old man
en.dek: The patient, who reported high-risk sexual contact in Hong Kong and abroad, is in stable condition at Princess Margaret Hospital after testing positive.
body: The Centre for Health Protection said on Wednesday that it is investigating a confirmed case of mpox, also known as monkeypox, involving a 41-year-old man.

The patient developed swollen lymph nodes on 21 October and a rash on his genital area and upper limbs from 24 October. He attended a social hygiene clinic under the Department of Health on 26 October and was arranged for isolation treatment at Princess Margaret Hospital. Laboratory tests on his clinical samples returned positive for the mpox virus. He is currently in stable condition.

According to the information provided by the patient, he had high-risk sexual exposure both in Hong Kong and outside Hong Kong during the incubation period. The source of infection remains under investigation. The centre is continuing its epidemiological investigation and will report the case to the World Health Organization.

Since 2022, Hong Kong has recorded 117 mpox cases, all in male patients, comprising 91 local cases, 25 imported cases and one with the source still under investigation. Of the 24 cases reported since August, all patients reported high-risk sexual behaviour during the incubation period. The centre noted a significant rise in cases in August and September, followed by a drop after multi-pronged prevention measures, including additional vaccination services that reached 660 high-risk individuals in the past month.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查一宗䆲歲男子猴痘確診個案
zh.dek: 病人在潛伏期內曾於本港及外地有高風險性接觸，現於瑪嘉烈醫院接受隔離治療，情況穩定。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心星期三表示，正調查一宗猴痘（又稱mpox）確診個案，涉及一名41歲男子。
病人於10月21日出現淋巴結腫大，10月24日起於生殖器官及上肢出現皮疹。他於10月26日到衞生署轄下社會衞生科診所求診，其後獲安排到瑪嘉烈醫院接受隔離治療。臨床樣本經化驗證實對猴痘病毒呈陽性反應，目前情況穩定。
根據病人提供的資料，他在潛伏期內曾於香港及外地有高風險性接觸，感染源頭仍有待調查。中心正繼續進行流行病學調查，並會將個案通報世界衞生組織。
自2022年至今，本港共錄得117宗猴痘個案，全部患者均為男性，包括91宗本地個案、25宗輸入個案及一宗感染源頭仍在調查。8月至今錄得的24宗個案中，所有患者均報稱在潛伏期內曾進行高風險性行為。中心指出，8月至9月個案曾大幅上升，採取多元防控措施後本月新增個案已顯著減少，過去一個月共為660名高風險人士接種疫苗。
